snippet.title: Quadrillion Carrots - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5152560/Quadrillion_Carrots/
Harvest an absurd number of carrots and turn hard work into complete chaos.
Unlock powerful tools, build helper robots, explore six farming zones, and discover carrots that are definitely not normal.

Quadrillion Carrots is coming to PS5 and Steam.
